item.summary: More airlines are unveiling new ways to let coach fliers experience a bit of first-class comfort without breaking the bank, like Air New Zealand’s “Skynest” and United Airlines new “Relax Row.”

item.title: Trump tells ABC News he thinks he can trust the Iranians
item.summary: President Donald Trump told ABC News he believes he can trust the Iranians and this will all be resolved "very soon."

item.title: WATCH: Spring allergies may worsen as warmer weather arrives
item.summary: Dr. Leonard Bielory, allergist and immunologist, explains what is driving seasonal allergies and how people can best manage symptoms.

item.title: WATCH: Police release video warning residents about high school 'senior assassin’ game
item.summary: The San Diego Police Department video outlines the potential dangers of the game, in which high schoolers "hunt" each other using water guns.

item.summary: Three-time Olympic gold medalist and ESPN analyst Aly Raisman joins ABC News Live from Texas, breaking down the must-watch routines at the gymnastics championship.

item.summary: ABC News' Melissa Adan and Father Sam Sawyer, editor in chief at America Media, discuss the pontiff's latest remarks in favor of peace.

item.title: WATCH: Jill Biden bids $35,000 for guest role on ‘Heated Rivalry’
item.summary: The former first lady raised her paddle at $35,000 at the LGBTQ Community Center’s annual Center Dinner Thursday night, but was quickly outbid.

item.title: Millions under severe weather threat following destructive storms
item.summary: As storms develop Friday afternoon, there is a chance for discrete supercells with very large hail, strong tornadoes and destructive, straight-line winds.

item.title: Trump's lawyers say they're 'in discussions' to resolve his $10B suit against the IRS
item.summary: Attorneys for President Trump say they are "in discussions" with the DOJ to potentially resolve a $10 billion lawsuit that Trump and his company filed against the IRS.
